about_the_game:
Drone Arsenal — A thrilling military arcade game about drones. Dive into the heart of modern battles and control three classes of drones. Your mission: destroy the enemy and turn the tide of war!

Unique mechanics blending realism and arcade action will keep you hooked:

- Find your strategy: Choose a drone suited to the task. Options include: a nimble kamikaze, a heavy-duty striker, and an ever-present scout.

- Equip your drone: Select the optimal payload, balancing weight, damage, and area of effect.

- Study and strike: Detect enemies, identify their weaknesses, and deliver devastating blows!

- Maneuver: Dodge enemy electronic warfare and air defenses to avoid destruction.

- Liberate territories: Capture bases to replenish ammo and unlock new launch points.

- Upgrade your fleet: Unlock new modules for three unique drone types.

- Conquer the war: Over 7 maps and 30 unique missions await you!

Additional features:

- Flexible camera: Switch between first- and third-person views for full control in combat.

- Realistic physics: Drones react to payload weight and air resistance, adding tactical depth.

- Smart AI: Enemies actively resist—soldiers fire accurately, and vehicles evade attacks. Drone cameras, equipped with advanced AI, scan enemies.

- Vibrant graphics: Stylized visuals with vivid colors and detailed landscapes.

- Call in artillery: Coordinate strikes with mortars, howitzers, and missiles.

Build your unique drone from over 70 modules and destroy more than 80 types of targets:

- Infantry

- Tanks

- Vehicles

- Artillery

- Anti-air systems

- Naval transport

- Air transport

- Ground structures

- Electronic warfare and air defenses

- Special equipment

Add to your wishlist to stay updated on the release and grab a discount!
